question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Give and take
solution:
The correct answer is- 'Obliging each other mutually.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's understand the meaning of the given idiom:
 
 
• **Give and take **mean *the exchange of mutual compromise or concession; negotiation*. (आपसी समझौता या रियायत का आदान-प्रदान; बातचीत)

 
 
• Example: *There's always going to be some **give and take **when new legislation is introduced in politics.*

 
 
 
 
 
 
• By the above meaning and example, we can say that 'Obliging each other mutually' is the correct answer.

Hence *option 1 *is the appropriate answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's learn the origin of the given idiom:
 
 
• This expression dates from the **eighteenth century**. The verbal form, to give and take, dates from the early **1500s**. “*Give and take is fair in all nations*,” wrote **Fannie Burney **in **1778**,
